column1: # Lines starting with # are disabled. Keep keys specific: Chinese has no word
# boundaries, so short common words can cause false replacements.
# A. Safe high-frequency fixes: wrong strings are unlikely normal words.
# B. Phrase-anchored fixes: do not shorten these keys.
# C. Domain-specific seed: AI, education, and model names.
# Disabled by default: common words that can be correct in normal text.
# Uncomment only for a narrow domain where the replacement is always desired.
